candidates.sentence: “As President, I will cut socialist government spending, reclaim our supply chains, cut taxes, and unleash American energy.

While Biden and congressional Democrats chose to spend $45 billion of taxpayer money to hire an army of IRS agents to target the middle class, we must redirect those resources into border security and give Border Patrol the support they need to keep our nation secure.
We will fight to ensure that America’s kids are learning how to read and write, not about gender transition and sexual identity.
With a 100% pro-life voting record, we must stand up against the radical Left pushing taxpayer-funded abortion up until the moment of birth.
Allowing pregnant moms to claim the Child Tax Credit for their unborn children, to further protect life, support mothers, and reduce the number of kids born into poverty.
“Security starts on our borders, but it doesn’t end there.
End sanctuary cities to stop illegal immigration,
Cut non-defense discretionary spending back to the pre-pandemic baseline.
Stop China from buying up our farmland, protect property rights from liberal regulators, and prevent the IRS from killing family farms.
